scope: All twelve comparison units explicitly listed on pp. 10-11 of Segal et al. 2016, checked against the transcription on pp. 8-9. Not a complete diplomatic collation of both columns.
notation_policy: Labels below normalize the editors' consonantal readings for comparison, not every printed dot or spacing feature. Supplied prefixes are explicitly separated. Unbracketed does not mean newly image-verified or independently certain. Printed dots and ghost-shape discussion remain governed by the cited edition pages.

units.impact: Spelling difference alone supplies no English change.
units.reported_other_evidence: SP לבונתה; no comprehensive Greek/Syriac apparatus claim.

units.impact: Spelling difference alone supplies no English change; the cakes must not be confused with the later wafers in the same verse.
Spelling difference alone supplies no English change.
The 4QLevb spelling difference alone supplies no English change.
units.reported_other_evidence: SP agrees locally; 4QLevb ניחוח. Separate QDR control is a transcription consultation, not an additional manuscript.

units.impact: Singular offering versus plural offerings could affect English. POB's singular matches the published En-Gedi/MT reading; no change selected.
units.reported_other_evidence: SP קרבניכם; the edition reports plural rendering in LXX and Peshitta, not an independently verified Hebrew back-translation.

units.impact: Presence of the Hebrew object marker does not require a different English action or object.
units.reported_other_evidence: SP inserts את between the verb and hand; normalized label does not reproduce the line's printed certainty dots.

units.english_excerpt: the pieces, the head, and the fat
units.impact: The local conjunction distinction does not automatically require changing English list punctuation; English coordination is separately reviewed.
units.reported_other_evidence: SP ואת; the edition aligns LXX and Peshitta with that alternative. The head is contextual, not part of this isolated En-Gedi unit.

units.impact: Object-marker omission does not by itself remove all or change the referent in English.
units.reported_other_evidence: SP omits the local את; absence is checked through the bounded priest/all sequence, not by searching for את anywhere in the verse.

units.english_excerpt: a grain offering from a pan
units.impact: Construct versus absolute form needs grammatical evaluation; this check does not settle pan terminology or approve the entire English clause.
He versus they could affect English. The edition prints only final ט of this verb outside the supplied prefix, followed by את. Do not count its reconstructed stem as visible evidence.
units.reported_other_evidence: Edition label [והפשי]ט agrees with MT/Peshitta; SP והפשיטו and LXX plural are reported. The latter versional reports were not independently collated in this pass.

units.impact: From there versus from it could affect English reference. POB already matches the published En-Gedi/MT wording; no change selected.
units.reported_other_evidence: Edition reports Peshitta with MT and SP ממנה with LXX; those versional labels are not independent direct collations here.

units.locator: II 12, p. 9; reading note p. 10; apparatus p. 11
units.impact: You versus he could affect English. Prefix ו is supplied, and the editors discuss a likely ghost stroke between aleph and tav. No extra ancient vav is accepted from that shape.
units.reported_other_evidence: Edition reports MT/SP/Peshitta second person against 4QLevb והביא and LXX third person. POB's later he clauses require a separate agency review; this opening-verb check does not resolve them.
